defense_prompts.prompt: Explain why the list result is appropriate for the supervisor's priority worklist.
Explain why order_id is the dictionary key and identify one duplicate-key or data-quality risk you would check before using this pattern on production data.

purpose: Use bounded Python comprehension skills to turn a small raw order dataset into a priority worklist and a late-order amount mapping for a supervisor review.

requirements.late_amount_rule: Return a dictionary mapping every late order ID to its amount.
requirements.priority_rule: Return order IDs whose status is late and amount is at least the threshold, preserving source order.

role_context: Junior operations analyst supporting a fulfillment team

rubric.description: Construct the required priority worklist with a list comprehension.
Construct the required late-order amount mapping with a dictionary comprehension.
Produce outputs that match the independently derived business rules.
Explain the implementation choice and identify a realistic data-quality risk.

title: Operations order-triage analysis
